tui_alternate_screen.label: Alternate Screen
tui_alternate_screen.help: Alternate screen strategy. auto automatically, always always on, never never; interactive sessions are usually taken over by the TUI alternate screen.

tui_mouse_capture.label: Mouse Capture
tui_mouse_capture.help: When enabled, supports internal scrolling, conversation selection, right-click menu, and scrollbar dragging; some terminals disable this by default.

tui_terminal_probe_timeout_ms.label: Terminal Probe Timeout
tui_terminal_probe_timeout_ms.help: Timeout for probing terminal mode (color, mouse protocol) at startup, default 500ms, range 100~5000.

tui_stream_chunk_timeout_secs.label: Stream Chunk Timeout
tui_stream_chunk_timeout_secs.help: Maximum idle time between two data chunks in the SSE stream, default 300s, range 1~3600, 0 maps to the default value.

tui_osc8_links.label: OSC 8 Links
tui_osc8_links.help: Wraps URLs with OSC 8 escape sequences, supporting Cmd+click navigation in iTerm2/Ghostty/Kitty/WezTerm.
